	random = no
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_action_running
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_researching.Brain
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_action_complete
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.3
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_action_tier_3
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.2
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_action_tier_2
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Brain.1
		}
	}
	text = { localisation_key = DA_DL_action_tier_1 }
}

defined_text = {
	name = DA_DL_GetStatus_Warrior
	random = no
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_running
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_researching.Warrior
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_complete
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.3
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_lab_3
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.2
			DA_DL_lab_tier_3 = no
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_lab_2
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.1
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.2 }
			DA_DL_lab_tier_2 = no
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_lab_1
		trigger = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_DL_unlocked.Warrior.1 }
			DA_DL_lab_tier_1 = no
		}
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_waiting
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = DA_DL_research_on
		}
	}
	text = { localisation_key = DA_DL_cell_ready }
}
